items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: only thing that was ever harder is we did some Larry Coryell recordings and that was direct to disc

ctx.x: Yeah just ridiculous arrangements and very tight. And all the records we did were with DMP and that was live to two track. So when you hear those records I think the most amazing thing is to know that it’s all live. You know there was no overdubbing, none of that stuff, and to have gotten that on record, as complicated as that music was. I guess the
